About the Just for Giggles Monday Night Ride group ride

An informal Rochester group that rides for fun and usually ends at a brewery. Monday evenings roll from Three Heads Brewing; Saturday mornings from Schoen Place in Pittsford. Over 3,000 members in the Facebook group, where each ride is posted.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
